notes: All 25 text files read. Institutions by host kept for every page; none belongs to another institution. Program-list pages: Columbia GSB (all five areas incl. Decision, Risk and Operations, 2006-2018), Fuqua Management and Organizations (2002-2018, lists current positions rather than first jobs), Goizueta job placements (2006-2013, all areas; no operations area) and Goizueta O&M dissertations page, HEC Montreal applied economics department (an economics unit inside a business school; some advisors such as Georges Zaccour and Michele Breton are operations/decision-sciences faculty, so kept as program-list for the integrator to classify; no graduation years), HEC Paris placement (2012-2019, includes Information Systems and Operations Management graduates) and HEC Paris 2018-2019 job-market page (two candidates, not placements). The seven GWU pages are current-student profiles of Strategic Management and Public Policy doctoral candidates captured in 2013, marked single-record because they identify the person and program (four state an expected PhD year) but none states a completed degree or a placement; they are roster-only evidence. The two Georgia Tech ISyE placement pages name employers and hiring institutions but no graduates (two testimonial names only), so they are not-a-list. The Erasmus RePub page is a repository feed across faculties; a dedicated ERIM dissertation list would be a better source.
